Codebook: Surveys

This document provides an overview of the variables assessed in the 25 ProPELL surveys. All questionnaires were administered via the online survey tool LimeSurvey.
Author

ProPELL/MBieleke

Published

March 11, 2026

Introduction

Survey names

The surveys in this codebook are named after the week in which they were collected: s00 represents the screening survey prior to the study and s01 to s21 represent the surveys during the 21 weeks of the study. The suffix indicates whether the questionnaire was completed on site in the laboratory (i.e., l) or online from home (i.e., o). For example, participants completed survey s08o online in Week 8.

The survey data are available as individual datasets in the ProPELL Data Hub. They can be joined as neccessary using the anonymous participant IDs.

Anonymized participant IDs

The participant IDs in these datasets are anonymized, as the code generated by the participants during the study (e.g., IKTENT20) only allows for pseudonymized data.

id

Anonymized ID

The mapping of anonymous and pseudonymous IDs is available here (only authorized PIs; requires login).

Variable names

Each variable has a prefix as part of its name. The prefix indicates whether a variable belongs to a screening (m0), pre-exercise (m1), post-exercise (m2), follow-up (m3), or weekly survey (w01 - w21). For example, m1_birthyear represents participant’s birthyear assessed in one of the pre-exercise surveys.

Overview

Figure 1 provides an overview of which questionnaires were completed by which of the 75 participants who started the ProPELL study. A green tile indicates that data is available, a red tile means that no data is available.

m0_check

Screening

De-identification note: All identifiers were removed and records were shuffled in a separate dataset.

  • Items
  • Distribution
  • Statistics
  • Source

In this part of the screening, we ask you for health-related information. Even if the connection to health is not immediately apparent for all questions, this information is important to determine whether you can participate in the measurement procedures of the ProPELL study. It is therefore important that you answer all questions thoroughly and truthfully. For some questions, if you answer “yes,” you will be asked to provide additional details. Please provide these details as precisely as possible.

Variable Label Prompt
m0_check01 Screening #01 (Mental disorder status) Are you currently suffering from a mental disorder?
m0_check02 Screening #02 (Physical illness status) Are you currently suffering from an acute physical illness?
m0_check03 Screening #03 (Chronic illness status) Do you suffer from a chronic illness?
m0_check04 Screening #04 (History of neurological disorder) Do you suffer from a neurological disorder? (e.g. epilepsy, stroke, Parkinson’s disease)
m0_check05 Screening #05 (History of endocrinological or metabolic disorder) Have you been diagnosed with an endocrinological or metabolic disorder? (e.g. over- or underactive thyroid, diabetes)
m0_check06 Screening #06 (History of Hepatitis B/C, HIV, or Cancer) Have you been diagnosed with hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV or cancer?
m0_check07 Screening #07 (History of heart or circulatory disease) Have you been diagnosed with a heart/circulatory disease? (e.g. aortic stenosis, mitral stenosis, cardiomyopathies, malignant or exercise-induced arrhythmias, syncope on exertion, intracardiac shunt, genetic channelopathies, recent myocardial infarction or heart failure, severe left ventricular dysfunction, severe pulmonary arterial hypertension)
m0_check08 Screening #08 (Autoimmune disease status) Do you suffer from an autoimmune disease?
m0_check09 Screening #09 (Claustrophobia status) Do you suffer from claustrophobia?
m0_check10 Screening #10 (History of traumatic brain injury) Have you ever had a traumatic brain injury (concussion) with loss of consciousness?
m0_check11 Screening #11 (Tinnitus status) Do you suffer from tinnitus?
m0_check12 Screening #12 (Bone fracture status) Did you have a bone fracture in the last year?
m0_check13 Screening #13 (Lower extremity injury status) Have you had a severe injury to the lower extremities in the last 6 months?
m0_check14 Screening #14 (Radiotherapy status) Are you currently receiving radiotherapy?
m0_check15 Screening #15 (Long-term glucocorticoid therapy status) Are you currently undergoing long-term therapy with glucocorticoids?
m0_check16 Screening #16 (Presence of active implants) Do you have a pacemaker, an implanted medication pump, other implants or other electromedical devices? (e.g. insulin pump, neurostimulator, shunt, artificial stoma with magnetic closure, artificial heart valve, etc.)
m0_check17 Screening #17 (Presence of metallic/conductive foreign bodies or passive implants) Are there possibly metallic and electrically conductive foreign bodies or implants in your body as a result of accidents or operations? (e.g. metal prosthesis, cochlear implant, inner ear prosthesis, vascular clip, osteosynthesis plate, stent, vena cava filter, metal or shrapnel fragments, etc.)
m0_check18 Screening #18 (Tattoo status) Do you have tattoos?
m0_check19 Screening #19 (Presence of permanent makeup or cosmetic eyelid procedures) Do you have permanent makeup (or have you had cosmetic eyelid procedures)?
m0_check20 Screening #20 (History of heart, head, or brain surgery) Have you ever had surgery on your heart, head or brain?
m0_check21 Screening #21 (Presence of metallic dental prostheses) Do you have metallic dental prostheses? For example retainers (wire behind the teeth), fixed braces, bridges, implants, etc.
m0_check22 Screening #22 (Medication status) Are you currently taking any medication?
m0_check23 Screening #23 (COVID-19 vaccination status) Are you vaccinated against COVID-19?
m0_check24 Screening #24 (Intrauterine device status) Do you have an intrauterine device (“coil” / “IUD”)?
m0_check25 Screening #25 (Possibility of current pregnancy) Is there a possibility that you are pregnant?
m0_check26 Screening #26 (Sports club membership status) Are you a member of a sports club?
m0_check27 Screening #27 (Non-club sports activity status) Do you practice any sport outside of a club? (e.g. privately in a group or alone, as part of commercial offers such as fitness studios or dance schools, health insurance programmes, company, trainee or university sports, physical education or courses at adult education centres)

Even if the connection to health is not immediately apparent for all questions, this information is important to determine whether you can participate in the measurement procedures of the ProPELL study. Variable Label Prompt
m0_check02d Screening #02d (Specification of physical illness) What illness are you suffering from?

m0_ipaq

IPAQ-SF 6 Months

  • Item
  • Distribution
  • Statistics
  • Source

We are interested in finding out what types of physical activities you perform in your everyday life. The following questions refer to the time you have spent on physical activity during an average week over the past 6 months. Please answer all questions (even if you do not consider yourself an active person). Please include activities performed as part of your work, in your home and garden, to get from place to place, and during your leisure time for recreation, fitness, and sport. In the following, think about all your vigorous and moderate activities during an average week over the past 6 months. Vigorous activities refer to activities that require strong physical effort and make you breathe much harder than normal. Moderate activities refer to activities that require moderate physical effort and make you breathe somewhat harder than normal.

N % %Val Mean SD Min Median Max
